title: Implement Parameterized Queries for VB6 to C# Migration
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating SQL injection vulnerabilities that must be eliminated in C# modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security vulnerability allowing unauthorized database access and data manipulation in banking system
suggested_approach: Replace concatenated SQL with parameterized queries using Entity Framework or Dapper in C# implementation
success_criteria: All SQL operations use parameterized queries
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in SQL

provenance.evidence: Direct SQL concatenation: WHERE AccountNo='" & txtAccountNo.Text & "'
Direct SQL concatenation in UPDATE statement

title: Define Database Migration Strategy
problem_statement: Database conversion context is unspecified, creating risk of data loss and system incompatibility during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Data loss, system downtime, and failed modernization due to incompatible database structures
suggested_approach: Conduct database discovery, create migration scripts, and establish rollback procedures
success_criteria: Validated migration scripts with rollback capability

provenance.evidence: DATABASE CONVERSION CONTEXT: source: not specified, target: not specified

title: Implement Banking-Grade Authentication
problem_statement: No authentication or authorization framework detected in current system, critical security gap for banking application
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to banking functions, regulatory compliance violations, data breaches
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect with multi-factor authentication and role-based access control
success_criteria: Audit logging for all authentication events

provenance.evidence: No authentication patterns detected in endpoint analysis

title: Reduce Module Coupling Complexity
problem_statement: High import coupling (1088 edges across 197 modules) creates maintenance and testing challenges
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult maintenance, circular dependencies, deployment complexity, testing challenges
suggested_approach: Implement dependency injection, create interface abstractions, and establish clear module boundaries
